definition: Conundrum means a puzzle or difficult problem.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word conundrum. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know conundrum should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Scheduling the twins' recitals is this spring's conundrum: both fall on Saturday at noon, in towns an hour apart.
A snag is a passing hitch, fixed by the time lunch is over; it sits far below a conundrum.
A puzzle stops short of a conundrum — it has an answer waiting once you're clever enough, while a conundrum resists even its cleverest readers.

A riddle is a puzzle posed as a game, with a clever answer waiting for whoever thinks sideways enough. A conundrum is no game: it is a real problem whose options undercut one another, and cleverness alone may never crack it.

A dilemma is a forced choice between exactly two bad options — you must walk through one door or the other. A conundrum is wider: any stubbornly hard problem, with two paths or ten, that resists every clean answer.

Conundrum began as a 1590s Oxford joke — students invented it as fake Latin nonsense, so it has no real Latin parts and no word family in English.

Conundrum names a problem that resists every clean answer — budgets, ethics, scheduling.
Its unit-mate paradox is different: a paradox may be true exactly as it stands, while a conundrum sits there demanding a solution nobody has.

conundrum: A puzzle stops short of a conundrum — it has an answer waiting once you're clever enough, while a conundrum resists even its cleverest readers.
The town of Marrow Point has argued about its lighthouse for eleven years.
The cliff beneath it loses a little ground to every winter storm, and engineers agree the tower will eventually fall if nothing is done.

Moving the lighthouse inland would save the structure but cost more than the town's entire yearly budget; leaving it in place means losing the coast's oldest landmark; building a seawall would protect the cliff while starving the beach below of sand.
Every option the council studies weakens the case for another, which is why the mayor has taken to calling the lighthouse the town's standing conundrum.
This year's meeting ended like the last ten: with a vote to keep studying.
